scope: Proposition 4.6 of the manuscript “A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model” (preprints/A-PD4-group-without-an-aspherical-manifold-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ccbbf7f15686b6f7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The manifold Y has two ∆-periodic systems of sphere pairs, with the same chamber labels: 1. framed immersed hyperbolic pairs in the interiors of the chambers Dv, including the added standard pairs, with their equivariant products already correct over the individual chamber group; 2. geometrically standard pairs with pairwise disjoint punctured S2 × S2 neighborhoods, based- homotopic sphere by sphere to the correspondingly labelled pairs in the first system. There is an integer d0 such that the drawing of each pair, its standard neighborhood, and the homotopies relating the two systems are contained in the chambers at gallery distance at most d0 from that pair’s label. Basings in this statement are local basings transported with the chamber; no bound is asserted for whiskers drawn from one global base point to all chambers.
